posts.text: India's financial savings and market participation have surged since 2020 — ON the FDs part what I meant was that many people who actually would be more or less putting their money into safer assets like FD are now pushing their money into equities via SIPs. Regarding the amount getting doubled in time deposits, there are always sane people who would prefer their money to be invested in FDs rather than putting it in SIPs blindly when the markets are this dicy.

posts.author: Amrit_Sairam
posts.text: India's financial savings and market participation have surged since 2020 — Both, and you can separate them. More people: unique mutual fund investors went from 2.08 crore in March 2020 to 6.19 crore by June 2026, about 3x. NSE-registered investors went from 3 crore to 13.5 crore, though only just over a third are active (4.57 crore in March, down 7% on the year). Richer: fund assets grew about 3.7x, faster than the headcount, partly because “since 2020” starts at the crash low. The Nifty 500 is up about 3x from 31 March 2020.
